DB-E6.Description:
Configure GitHub Actions to sign Docker images with cosign keyless signing.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Add cosign to CI workflow
- Use GitHub OIDC for keyless signing (no private keys to manage)
- Sign after push to registry: cosign sign --yes {image}@{digest}
- Add verification step: cosign verify --certificate-identity-regexp=.* --certificate-oidc-issuer=https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
- Store signature in same registry as image
- Document verification command in infrastructure/AGENT.md
- Workflow permissions: id-token: write, contents: read, packages: write

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Infrastructure
DEPENDENCIES: DB-010

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Image signed after build
- Signature verifiable with cosign
- OIDC identity matches GitHub Actions
- Unsigned images rejected in production

EDGE CASES:
- Signing failure: fail the build
- Registry doesn't support signatures: document workaround
- Verify command documented clearly

Implement comprehensive health and readiness endpoints for production deployment.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- GET /health: basic liveness check (returns 200 if app is running)
- GET /health/ready: readiness check (verifies MCP connections, LLM availability)
- Include: database connectivity, MCP server status, LLM provider status
- Return structured response: {status, checks: [{name, status, latency_ms}]}
- Use for Kubernetes/Container Apps probes
- Timeout individual checks at 5 seconds

EFFORT: S (3 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: DB-006, DB-011, DB-016

TESTING CRITERIA:
- /health always returns 200 if app running
- /health/ready fails if dependency down
- Response includes check details
- Timeouts enforced

EDGE CASES:
- Partial failure: return 200 with degraded status
- Check timeout: report as unhealthy
- Don't cache health results

Implement graceful shutdown for SIGTERM handling in production.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Register signal handlers for SIGTERM and SIGINT
- On signal: stop accepting new requests
- Wait for in-flight requests to complete (max 30 seconds)
- Close MCP connections gracefully
- Close database connection pool
- Flush pending telemetry
- Exit with code 0 on clean shutdown
- Log shutdown sequence with timing

EFFORT: S (2 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: DB-006, DB-011

TESTING CRITERIA:
- SIGTERM triggers graceful shutdown
- In-flight requests complete
- Connections closed properly
- Exit code 0 on success

EDGE CASES:
- Long-running request: wait up to 30s then force close
- Connection close fails: log and continue
- Double signal: force immediate exit
